label: batch-96
tail:
Batch 96 drafting and evidence are complete. I added the local sutured Floer and relative Spin-c definitions, the Poincaré-sphere homology lemma, and the reducible-exterior counterexample. The A/B pages have inventories only and empty bodies.

Six items are marked `ready`: four definitions and the two topology items with complete local proofs. Six deeper claims remain `escalated` with their proof gaps recorded. The Ni claims cover general \(Y\), but the planned JSJ supplier is absent as an item and its manifest statement covers only knots in \(S^3\) under full AC. The existing grid comparison is mod two, so it does not establish the assigned integral claims. [Ni, *Knot Floer homology detects fibred knots*](https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0607156v4), [MOS, *A combinatorial description of knot Floer homology*](https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0607691v2)

Scoped statement, proof-layout, proof-contract, content-policy, coverage, and source-fetch checks pass. Batch 96’s inventories and dependency levels are consistent. The run-wide dependency check still reports empty inventories in other batches and an unrelated level mismatch for `cex-knot-kt-21-boundary-case`. Native run status remains `running` at 84/109, with the owner repair/recertification hold active. No tests were run.

The handoff records are [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-96.notes.md), [cross-batch dependencies](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-96.cross-batch-dependencies.json), [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-96.proof-contracts.json), and [source coverage](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-96.coverage.json). The [A page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/knot-theory/knot-floer-genus-and-fiberedness-detection.md) and [B page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/knot-theory/knot-floer-genus-and-fiberedness-detection-examples.md) remain drafts; no independent approval or publication is claimed.
